blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Health (DOH) on Saturday activated code white alert amid the potential effects of Severe Tropical Storm Queenie. According to the DOH in an advisory, code white places its operations center under 24/7 alert to ensure timely response in the affected areas. READ: Pagasa: Queenie nears typhoon category It is also meant to tell the public of the department’s continued coordination with relevant agencies, local government units and regional disaster units. “Although not expected to make landfall, the storm will still bring heavy rains and the threat of flooding,” said the DOH. “That’s why the DOH […]...
